issues.reason: The PartOf half is refuted — PartOf's second licensed job is 'a member of a group', an organization member fits it, and the tense rule expressly contemplates 'any PartOf the clause asserts' under a past wrapper, so this is licensed improvisation in uncovered affiliation territory; the half that stands is the untyped conference_board symbol, repaired under issue 1.

Names and casing directs 'State the entity's kind in one ordinary type atom instead — whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it' (the 'the Kestrel River' -> (Member kestrel_river river) case), so the kind word inside 'Conference Board' owes a type atom.

'finally' is a phasal/expectation particle of the again/still/already/yet family, and that section says in as many words 'do not stuff these into Manner' while fixing the tag list at exactly four — so with no licensed carrier the adverbial must be left out, not mis-slotted.

The licensed hedges are the symmetric about/around/approximately (sigma ~10%) and roughly (sigma ~20%) families; N(1.5, 0.15) puts half its mass above 1.5, which 'almost a year and a half' explicitly excludes, so the atom asserts what the text denies.

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation as a speech verb's complement — only a finite that-clause is specified, and the verbatim/quotation status has no carrier
affiliation carried by a proper-noun modifier on a role noun ('Conference Board economist') — compound fusion excludes proper nouns and the genitive rule needs a possessive marker
directional approximators ('almost', 'nearly', 'just over') on a measured quantity — only symmetric hedges have a licensed distribution
discourse/phasal adverbs such as 'finally' — the opaque aspectual tags are a closed set of four
new_gaps: BeforeBy has no bounded twin (no BeforeByAtMost/AtLeast) the way Measure and Time do, so a hedged temporal gap can only be degraded to the bare Before ordering
repair_summary: Added (Member conference_board board) — the naming rule's kind atom for the kind word sitting inside the name. Removed (Manner sk_point_1 finally) — no licensed slot for the phasal adverb. Replaced the BeforeBy atom's symmetric (ParticleFromNormal 1.5 0.15) magnitude with the bare (Before sk_end_1 sk_point_1) ordering, keeping the stated sequence and dropping the unrepresentable directional hedge.
notes: The BeforeBy argument order, the To-oblique on the prepositional verb 'point to', and the projection of the definite 'end'/'recession' typing outside the seal while 'a recovery' stays inside were all correct and are preserved. Only the measured gap is lost; the ordering it carried is kept.
